Consent.description: The owner's consent record, kept on the device and reported with every heartbeat (S2.6).
Consent.title: Consent

Contribution.description: The contribution governor's current level (S4.9, D-12).
Contribution.title: Contribution

CrashReportIn.description:
An agent panic or a worker crash (S4.3; PROJECT_PLAN §6a CrashReport). Text fields are redacted by the agent
before they are written; the coordinator never receives prompt or response text.
CrashReportIn.title: CrashReportIn

ErrorsRecord.description:
How many warnings and errors the agent logged per error code since its last record (S3.5). Codes only:
the messages stay in the node's log file (and a diagnostic bundle, S4.4).
ErrorsRecord.title: ErrorsRecord

Hardware.description: The node's hardware profile (S3.3) and the inference backends it can run (S3.4).
Hardware.title: Hardware

HealthRecord.description:
Node health (S3.5; PROJECT_PLAN §6 NodeHealthSample). Counters count from the agent's start and reset
only together with agent_uptime_s, so a reset is never silent.
HealthRecord.title: HealthRecord

IdleRecord.description: One idle sample (PROJECT_PLAN §6 IdleSample). Never anything typed or shown on the machine.
IdleRecord.title: IdleRecord

LidRecord.description: A laptop lid opened or closed (S3.1). Sent once at start and on every change.
LidRecord.title: LidRecord

LogLevelIn.description: Raise (or lower) one node's log level for a limited time (S4.5). minutes=0 ends a window early.
LogLevelIn.title: LogLevelIn

NetEdgeRecord.description:
One network measurement from this node to a peer node or to the coordinator (S5.1, S5.2; PROJECT_PLAN
§6 NetEdge). `dst` is the peer's device ID, or "coordinator". The RTT probe and the bandwidth test run on
different schedules, so a record carries the RTT pair, the bandwidth, or both.
NetEdgeRecord.title: NetEdgeRecord

NetworkId.description: The subnet of the interface the node uses to reach this coordinator (S5.1). Never the host address.
NetworkId.title: NetworkId

StateRecord.description: A node-state change. After a sleep the agent sends one at the start of the gap and one on waking.
StateRecord.title: StateRecord

info.description: Distributed Inference For All coordinator prototype. Fake runtime only.
info.title: DIFA Coordinator

post.description: Rotates credentials and revokes sessions and API keys; issues a new recovery code (spec 6.5).
Visibility changes create a new branch with immutable visibility (FR 18).
One-time code a member gives to the agent on their own device (spec 6.3 headless flow).
An agent uploads a crash report it saved (its own panic, or its worker's exit). Repeats are ignored.
The agent's answer to a request: the bundle as one JSON object (at most 1 MiB).
Agents report capabilities and their locally enforced state; the response renews the lease.

get.description: Byte ranges of the model a device is assigned to prefetch (FR 30), for LAN or test use.

patch.description: Owners set limits; administrators may only disable. Agents also apply local ceilings (FR 07).

get.description: The decode-probe reference model (S5.6), whole, for an enrolled device over the pinned channel.

post.description:
Idle samples, state changes, health and error counts from an agent's on-disk buffer (S2.3, S2.4,
S3.5). Repeats are ignored. Each record kind needs its own consent: idle data or diagnostics.
Local bootstrap only: the coordinator host creates the group (FR 01).
Plan with the filter-and-score pipeline, then load (FR 13, FR 14, FR 31).

Test a device's link to this coordinator now (S5.2, D-25 admin request). Group administrators only.
Skips the off-hours rule, but not the others: the owner's consent, the governor, and a link in use.
Ask a node for a diagnostic bundle. It is built and uploaded after the node's next heartbeat.

get.description: A device's idle samples and state changes, for its owner or a group administrator.

post.description:
Open a window in which one node logs at `level`; it reverts by itself after `minutes`, on the node too,
even if the coordinator is unreachable then. minutes=0 closes the window now.

delete.description: Revokes sessions, credentials, and devices and cancels queued and running work (FR 04).

get.description:
The network graph of the group's devices: measured links, whether each link is fast enough to
join a cluster, and each device's cluster (S5.4). Group administrators only.
The last bandwidth test of each device since the coordinator started, and when the next is due.
Content-free queue view for administrators: positions and states, never prompts.

post.description: Shows the group name and fingerprint before joining (FR 03). Discloses no content.

get.description: Agent and worker crash reports (S4.3) from the group's nodes, newest first.

Error events per code per time bucket, by source (a node's name, or coordinator). `codes` is a
comma-separated list to count only those, or "network" for the network view's probe-health codes.
Node health samples (S3.5), oldest first, one row per node per sample.
Share of time idle by day of week and hour, across the group's nodes or one node (by name).
The network map as node-graph frames (S5.5): part=nodes or part=edges.
Network figures over time (S5.5): RTT and bandwidth per node and link, optionally one method only.
Each node's subnet, cluster and newest figures to the coordinator (S5.5).
Every node in the group with its hardware profile, backends and current state (S3.3, S3.4).
Idle samples with each node's state, oldest first, for a state timeline.
Owner-scoped event stream with replay from Last-Event-ID (spec 9.3).
